scripts.check:browser: node -e "const { chromium } = require('playwright'); (async()=>{ const browser = await chromium.launch({ channel: 'chrome', headless: true }); const page = await browser.newPage(); await page.goto('about:blank'); await browser.close(); console.log('Chrome OK'); })().catch(e=>{ console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); });"
